_doc: Default take-check thresholds (v1.1). Pass this file with --config, or copy the keys under a top-level take_check object in a client's reel-style.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Missing keys fall back to these defaults. Every number here is a threshold, not a measurement. Soft (yellow): fillers_per_min_max, low_confidence_max, longest_pause_s, restarts_per_min_max, and hook_max_s (tip takes only). Hard (red / silent): min_speech_s and min_words. pause_s is the gap that counts as a pause. low_word_prob is the word probability below which a word is low-confidence. no_speech_prob_min: a take is silent when every segment is above this. Restarts: a run of restart_min_n to restart_max_n words that repeats within restart_window_s seconds, or a run of restart_adjacent_n words repeated back to back (0 turns that off); a run made only of restart_stopwords never counts. min_window_s is the shortest window the judge may grade; a take that speaks for less than this is kind line and its minimum is its own clean span. episode_keywords: a stem token (split on - and _) matching one of these, any case, makes the take kind episode; otherwise tip (--kind overrides). fillers is the phrase list (do not add 'like'). setup_cues are slate words matched only in the first setup_window_s. silence_phrases are whole-text hallucinations, not substrings. prefixes are folder-scan stem prefixes (--prefix overrides, --all ignores). judge_cmd is the argv of the model judge; it runs in an empty temp dir and the prompt is written to stdin unless an element contains {prompt}. The default is Claude Code print mode on Sonnet with no tools, no MCP servers, no settings sources, and no saved session. Alternative Grok judge: ["pi", "-p", "--no-tools", "--no-mcp", "--model", "xai/grok-4.7", "--thinking", "low"]. judge_timeout_s and jobs bound the judge.
judge_cmd: You are a strict scoring judge. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else.
